players.product: Formulated epoxy resins for AI semiconductors: liquid molding compound (LMC) and advanced sheet molding compound (a-SMC) encapsulants (Nagase ChemteX)

quarterly_data.quarter: Nagase & Co. annual securities report: FY2026 (06-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 consolidated results: net sales JPY 972,783 million vs JPY 944,961 million (+2.9%); gross profit JPY 187,687 million (+8.3%); operating income JPY 44,727 million vs JPY 39,078 million (+14.5%); net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 33,119 million (+29.8%). Management states profit rose at every level although the yen strengthened; gross profit rose on higher sales and improved profitability at some manufacturing subsidiaries; net income also reflected a gain on negative goodwill and larger gains on sales of investment securities, partly offset by a business-withdrawal loss on the thin-glass-substrate processing business in China that the company had decided to exit.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 972,783 million (+2.9%); operating income JPY 44,727 million (+14.5%); net income JPY 33,119 million (+29.8%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Nagase & Co. annual securities report: FY2026 (06-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Electronics & Energy segment, fiscal year ended March 2026: sales JPY 172,891 million vs JPY 161,315 million (+7.2%); gross profit JPY 45,331 million (+13.2%); operating income JPY 14,859 million vs JPY 12,302 million (+20.8%). Management attributes the gross-profit increase to higher sales of semiconductor materials; higher sales of Nagase ChemteX modified epoxy resins, where products for AI semiconductors stayed solid while those for mobile devices were weak; and strong wafer-bumping equipment sales and bumping contract services at the Pac Tech group. The Functional Materials segment also reported higher sales of raw materials for semiconductor materials.
quarterly_data.figure: Electronics & Energy sales JPY 172,891 million (+7.2%); operating income JPY 14,859 million (+20.8%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Nagase & Co. annual securities report: FY2026 (06-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Review of the ACE 2.0 mid-term plan, semiconductor field: centred on Nagase ChemteX, the company expanded production capacity for liquid encapsulants for advanced semiconductors, for which demand is rising sharply, and advanced development of a-SMC, a new material for next-generation packages. It also acquired the Asian semiconductor high-purity chemicals business of US-based SACHEM (now the Nagase Circrea group) and opened a new plant in Higashiosaka, Osaka for recovering and recycling TMAH, a chemical used in semiconductor manufacturing; the company calls this the first TMAH recovery and recycling business in Japan.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nagase & Co. annual securities report: FY2026 (06-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer Rapidus: the company states it was selected as the materials transport coordinator for Rapidus, which aims to manufacture leading-edge semiconductors in Japan, on the strength of its network, expertise and specialised logistics know-how as a trading company, and that it is contributing in a core position to building the next-generation semiconductor supply chain.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nagase & Co. annual securities report: FY2026 (06-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Mid-term plans: under ACE 2.0 the final-year financial goals of ROE of 8.0% or more and operating income of 350 (100 millions of yen) were both met, with ROE 8.0% and operating income 447. The new mid-term plan Walk the Talk 2028 targets, for its final year, operating income of 500 (100 millions of yen) or more and ROE of 9.0% or more, and aims for early achievement of a market capitalisation of JPY 1 trillion. Segments are reorganised: Functional Materials, Advanced Materials & Processing and Mobility merge into a Materials segment, Electronics & Energy is renamed Electronics and Life & Healthcare is renamed Life Sciences; capital is to be allocated preferentially to the more profitable Electronics and Life Sciences segments.
quarterly_data.figure: Walk the Talk 2028 final-year targets: operating income 500 or more (100 millions of yen), ROE 9.0% or more

quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year ended March 2026 capex (including intangible assets) totalled JPY 26,517 million, of which Electronics & Energy JPY 4,591 million; R&D expenses totalled JPY 5,934 million, of which Electronics & Energy JPY 1,879 million. Electronics & Energy production sites listed include the Nagase ChemteX Harima works (Tatsuno, Hyogo), Nagase Chemtex America (Ohio, industrial adhesives), Pac Tech Asia (Penang, Malaysia; semiconductor manufacturing equipment) and a high-purity chemicals plant in Wuxi, China.
